Guests board directly from Waikiki Beach near the Outrigger Reef Waikiki Beach Resort. Tours include open bar (except snorkeling where alcohol is cash only) and professional guides.

quotes.text: Our Waikiki Sunset Cruise did not disappoint! The cruise was one of the highlights of our vacation. We saw a whale and an unbelievable sunset all while enjoying drinks with a great group on the boat. Our captain and bartender were awesome and we highly recommend this experience to all.

We had a great time at the turtle canyon morning snorkel tour. The crew was super friendly and helpful and it was very safe, even you had never snorkeled before you could enjoy this. We saw half a dozen different turtles, surfacing and all. Awesome experience.
So glad I went. We drove all around went swimming and heard all sorts of stories. Thank you for the Great time and service. I highly recommend Hokai Catamaran
We absolutely enjoyed our sunset sail with Holokai Catamaran! All the drink, view, and crew members were amazing.
